title: Parent _ready / _process are no longer called automatically

blocks.text:
Parent engine methods such as _ready, _process etc are not called
automatically anymore; you have to manually call them using super._ready().
This is completely different from Godot 3 and does not raise an error —
the parent implementation (including EditorPlugin and other engine
virtuals) simply never runs. Addon and subclass scripts that overrode
_ready without calling super will look "migrated" but silently skip
parent setup.
